nonObvious.text: Personal passion does not establish paid demand.

nonObvious.note: Owner/report evidence from outside NYC; lesson is an inference, not an NYC incidence estimate.

nonObvious.text: Several small increases can defeat an otherwise viable model.
nonObvious.why: Single-line sensitivity checks miss their combined effect.

nonObvious.text: A longstanding community cafe can close without a demand collapse.
nonObvious.why: The owner may need a different life and find no successor.

nonObvious.text: Closing still requires cash for packing down and legal work.

failureStories.cause: The owner says the cafe did not generate income.
failureStories.lesson: Test paying demand before building a personally attractive concept.
failureStories.quote: Она просто не приносила денег.

failureStories.cause: Jen Weiss attributed closure to combined rent, electricity, produce, staffing and tax costs.
failureStories.lesson: Review the combined bill stack.
failureStories.quote: something I can no longer fight

failureStories.cause: Reporting says the family sought a different working life but found no successor.
failureStories.lesson: Start succession planning before the owner needs to leave.
failureStories.quote: no haya encontrado relevo

failureStories.cause: The family described a lease dispute; reporting also records legal and packing-down costs.
failureStories.lesson: Budget for the cost of leaving, not only opening.
failureStories.quote: significant
failureStories.quoteAttribution: Cafe statement on packing-down costs, quoted in reporting

failureStories.what: Finch's Tea House, West Pender closed its premises.
failureStories.cause: Reporting connects closure with accumulated debt, cost increases, vandalism and adjacent construction; another location continued.
failureStories.lesson: Treat a rescue fundraiser separately from recurring viability.
failureStories.quote: there is no way to dig ourselves out
failureStories.quoteAttribution: Sheryl Matthew, earlier statement reproduced by Noms

failureStories.cause: The regulator cited layout preventing separation of raw and prepared food, alongside other hygiene problems.
failureStories.lesson: Resolve workflow separation before opening.
failureStories.quote: пересечения сырья с готовой продукцией

failureStories.cause: The report says the end was planned as part of an experiment, not caused by bankruptcy.
failureStories.lesson: Do not label every closure a business failure.
failureStories.quote: предполагалось заранее

failureStories.what: Townhouse Coffee and Cafe, Eaton closed its premises.
failureStories.cause: Owners cited rising costs and pressure, and felt public support was inadequate; that complaint is not an audited causal finding.
failureStories.lesson: A survival plan must work without unawarded assistance.
failureStories.quote: survive on your own

failureStories.what: SandwiChez, Sant Cugat closed its premises.
failureStories.cause: Company sources said increased occupancy cost prevented profit.
failureStories.lesson: Evaluate each location independently of brand popularity.
failureStories.quote: la subida les impide tener beneficios

failureStories.what: Nowhere Coffee Co., South Mountain closed its premises.
failureStories.cause: Owners reported snowmelt roof leaks damaging espresso machines, grinders, stock and wooden surfaces.
failureStories.lesson: Protect the whole counter zone and verify building leak responsibility.
failureStories.quote: It will be some time before we can reopen Emmaus
failureStories.quoteAttribution: Juan Vargas, quoted by public media

failureStories.what: Ubora Coffee Roasters closed its premises.
failureStories.cause: A burst pipe caused water damage; drying, construction and replacement-part delays extended the shutdown.
failureStories.lesson: Reopening depends on the slowest restoration task.
failureStories.quote: Some of them don’t know we’re open yet.

failureStories.what: Sisters Coffee, Pearl District closed its premises.
failureStories.cause: Sprinklers activated by an upstairs residential fire caused water damage throughout the cafe.
failureStories.lesson: Review exposures from neighboring occupancies.
failureStories.quote: water damage throughout the shop

failureStories.what: Model T Coffee closed its premises.
failureStories.cause: Owner cited staffing and area challenges, including weak footfall, construction and nearby closures; customers also confused it with its predecessor.
failureStories.lesson: A former cafe address can carry the wrong brand identity.
failureStories.quote: constant struggles
failureStories.quoteAttribution: Matthew Morgan, search excerpt quoting owner

failureStories.what: Fuel Coffee, Broadway counter closed its premises.
failureStories.cause: Owner Danielle Hulton clarified that operating logistics and business fit drove closure; reader speculation about crime was not her stated cause.
failureStories.lesson: Separate operating-model evidence from online speculation.
failureStories.quote: business and logistical issues
failureStories.quoteAttribution: CHS summary of Danielle Hulton clarification

failureStories.cause: Reporting links closure to a public menu-language dispute; landlord confirmed the space was vacated. This is reported sequence, not audited sole causation.
failureStories.lesson: Escalating review replies can damage trust.
failureStories.quote: Бизнес закрылся, офис пустует, арендатора больше нет.
failureStories.quoteAttribution: Landlord statement reproduced by Masa Media

failureStories.what: Main Street Commissary closed its premises.
failureStories.cause: Owner Daphne Ling says rent increases, staffing difficulty and higher goods costs made profit prospects too weak.
failureStories.lesson: Count owner cover shifts as a limited resource.
failureStories.quote: our prospects of ever turning a profit just seemed too bleak

failureStories.what: Mocha Mott's, Vineyard Haven closed its premises.
failureStories.cause: Reporting says a partner retirement and buyout led to sale of this location; the other cafe continued.
failureStories.lesson: A partner exit may require selling operating assets.
failureStories.quote: moving on for another common reason: retirement

failureStories.cause: Jin Sang-heon described nearby low-price entrants, attempted morning discounts and continuing losses.
failureStories.lesson: Do not assume matching a rival price preserves contribution.
failureStories.quote: coffee shops are competitively cutting prices to stay afloat

failureStories.what: Common Ground Cafe closed its premises.
failureStories.cause: The owner abruptly shut the cafe; this source does not establish his reason. Workers later reopened it as a cooperative.
failureStories.lesson: An exit can preserve the operating team through a different ownership structure.
failureStories.quote: It was a moment of shock.

failureStories.what: The Goodsline Cafe closed its premises.
failureStories.cause: Reporting identifies rising rent and declining discretionary demand; Jack Hanna described guests cutting back.
failureStories.lesson: Acclaim and expensive fit-out do not secure repeat spending.
failureStories.quote: The cost of living started to bite

failureStories.what: The French Connection closed its premises.
failureStories.cause: Owners thanked customers who continued during roadworks; the outlet described roadworks as a possible factor, not a proven sole cause.
failureStories.lesson: Track business-park access during prolonged public works.
failureStories.quote: we are now permanently closed

failureStories.cause: Staff did not open and posted that wages had not been paid; reporting also describes tax debts.
failureStories.lesson: Payroll cash must be ring-fenced before discretionary spending.
failureStories.quote: We have not been paid
failureStories.quoteAttribution: Staff sign quoted by Urban Milwaukee

failureStories.cause: The report attributes closure to falling sales and rising costs; an online equipment auction followed.
failureStories.lesson: Liquidation recovers only what buyers actually bid.
failureStories.quote: Hoy me toca despedirme de Forza

failureStories.cause: Shawn Koh said fatigue caused his exit despite good fundamentals; keeping successive viral products increased complexity.
failureStories.lesson: Retire menu items instead of accumulating every hit.
failureStories.quote: because I was tired

failureStories.cause: Krystal Nguyen declined renewal after staffing demands left little personal or family time.
failureStories.lesson: A staffed cafe may still depend on constant owner attendance.
failureStories.quote: little time for herself or her family

failureStories.cause: Anthony Lim relinquished a separately leased kitchen after a steep renewal proposal, converting another unit to online bakery sales.
failureStories.lesson: Split premises can have independent lease risks.
failureStories.quote: We had many issues with the landlord

failureStories.cause: Inspectors responding to a public complaint found rodent evidence, an entry hole and incomplete hygiene records; the operator closed to improve conditions.
failureStories.lesson: Correct entry routes and waste handling, not only visible signs.
failureStories.quote: closed the business and began making the necessary improvements

failureStories.cause: The landlord let the lease expire despite the operators hoping to renew.
failureStories.lesson: Renewal needs a signed agreement.
failureStories.quote: the closure was unexpected
failureStories.quoteAttribution: Chronicle reporting owners Patrick and Joanna Ascaso

failureStories.cause: Closed with parent SanDai; reporting says midweek restaurant business was insufficient.
failureStories.lesson: Shared businesses inherit each other’s fixed-cost exposure.
failureStories.quote: midweek business was ultimately insufficient

failureStories.cause: Berkeley Eats reported lease end and rent increase; the owner’s farewell did not state a reason.
failureStories.lesson: Preserve attribution when closure explanations differ.
failureStories.quote: The note did not cite a specific reason
